title: Meltano Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: Meltano ELT run logs via UF and the Meltano Cloud API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=meltano:run
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(exit_code!=0)) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Meltano and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Meltano is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Meltano logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Meltano error rate with anomaly band.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Meltano errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
